page_title: SAL 1-2 VER | Salernitana v Verona 20/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Ruben Vinagre (Verona) is on for Darko Lazovic.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' 1 - 2 Goal! Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:2.
90' Post! Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) pounces on the rebound inside the penalty box and tries to prod home! He's unlucky as the ball only rattles the left post.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Salernitana will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
88' 6:17 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
87' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle after Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
85' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
83' A substitution has been made. Grigoris Kastanos goes off and Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) comes on.
81' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Tomas Suslov will be replaced by Daniel Silva (Verona).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Folorunsho leaves the pitch and Karol Swiderski (Verona) comes on.
80' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
79' Diego Coppola (Verona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' Salernitana are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
78' Looks like Diego Coppola (Verona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
77' The referee points to the corner flag and Salernitana will take a corner.
76' Substitution. Shon Weissman walks off the pitch and Gerardo Fusco (Salernitana) comes on as a substitute.
73' Suat Serdar (Verona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
73' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
72' Stefano Colantuono has decided to substitute Federico Fazio and he is replaced by Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana).
71' Toma Basic (Salernitana) will miss the next game.
71' Toma Basic (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Marco Di Bello and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' It will be a substitution. Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona) is ready to enter the pitch as Juan Cabal walks off.
66' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Salernitana.
63' The Verona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

60' What a poor attempt! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
59' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
57' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
56' Ondrej Duda (Verona) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ondrej Duda (Verona) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Vincenzo Fiorillo makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Tijjani Noslin (Verona) after a cross from the side.
55' Suat Serdar (Verona) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
55' Suat Serdar (Verona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Marco Di Bello blows the whistle, Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is penalised for a foul.
51' Suat Serdar (Verona) produces a long-range strike, but he only hits one of his own teammates standing in its way.
49' The total number of attempts is 0:12.
48' Chance! Tijjani Noslin (Verona) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
46' Stefano Colantuono has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Antonio Candreva comes on the pitch for Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana).
46' Stefano Colantuono has made a change at the break. Giulio Maggiore has come on in place of Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' 0 - 2 Goal! Darko Lazovic puts the ball across the area and Michael Folorunsho (Verona) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 0:2.

45+2' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) produced a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Vincenzo Fiorillo thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
45+1' Salernitana take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Salernitana, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
41' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
40' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 41:59.
37' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
37' Darko Lazovic (Verona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
35' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) commits a foul after dangerous play.
33' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Salernitana was in an offside position.
31' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
30' Salernitana couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lorenzo Montipo (Verona) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
28' Darko Lazovic (Verona) takes the free kick from long range and unleashes a strong shot. Unfortunately for him the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance!
27' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
27' 0:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
25' Verona are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
25' Marco Di Bello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
22' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Tijjani Noslin provided an assist for the goal.
22' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Vincenzo Fiorillo reads it well and gathers the ball.

21' Darko Lazovic (Verona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Verona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' CHANCE! Tijjani Noslin (Verona) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he sends his shot well wide of the left post.
18' Diego Coppola (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for an infringement.
17' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
17' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Darko Lazovic (Verona) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
16' Tomas Suslov (Verona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Vincenzo Fiorillo to dive and make a save.
14' Verona are awarded a mid-range free kick.
14' Junior Sambia (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
12' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
10' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) is flagged for offside.
10' Vincenzo Fiorillo (Salernitana) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' Vincenzo Fiorillo (Salernitana) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
8' Wonderful pass from Ondrej Duda (Verona) for Tijjani Noslin, but they can't profit from it as Vincenzo Fiorillo comes off his line to collect.
6' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' Tomas Suslov (Verona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
4' Darko Lazovic (Verona) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
4' Darko Lazovic (Verona) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

2' Ambitious effort from Tijjani Noslin (Verona). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
1' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The match has just started.
Salernitana will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Marco Di Bello.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
